### Larder & Vine — Win-Back Campaign (Launch: मंगलवार, 6 जनवरी 2026)

> आधार: 60-180 दिन पहले cancel, भारत-IST, scheduler UTC (IST = UTC+5:30)

#### 1. Audience Table — Suppression + Coverage के बाद Eligible

**Formulas:** 
`Eligible Email = Email Opt-in − Suppressed − Coverage Excl. (non-suppressed, out-of-area)` 
`Eligible SMS = SMS Opt-in − Coverage Excl.` — SMS पहले से de-duplicated + non-suppressed हैं।

| Segment / Reason | Contacts | Email Opt-in | Suppressed | Coverage Excl. Email | **Eligible Email** | SMS Opt-in | Coverage Excl. SMS | **Eligible SMS** |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A - बहुत महँगा | 8,400 | 7,980 | 260 | 0 | **7,720** | 2,100 | 0 | **2,100** |
| B - व्यस्त / यात्रा | 5,200 | 4,940 | 150 | 0 | **4,790** | 1,560 | 0 | **1,560** |
| C - Quality शिकायत | 1,900 | 1,710 | 90 | 0 | **1,620** | 380 | 0 | **380** |
| D - Area से बाहर | 1,100 | 1,045 | 40* | 757 | **248** | 220 | 168 | **52** |
| E - No reason | 3,400 | 3,060 | 75 | 0 | **2,985** | 680 | 0 | **680** |
| **Total** | **20,000** | **18,735** | **615** | **757** | **17,363** | **4,940** | **168** | **4,772** |

*D के 40 suppressed सभी non-Pune हैं। D में Pune PIN: 260 contacts = 248 email + 52 SMS। `1,045 − 40 − 757 = 248`। बाकी D coverage से बाहर — exclude।

#### 2. Sequence Plan

सभी Email: **10:00-11:00 IST = 04:30-05:30 UTC**। सभी SMS: Header `LRDVIN`, DLT-approved template, **12:00-13:00 IST = 06:30-07:30 UTC** (TRAI 10:00-21:00 IST के अंदर)।

| Step | Day (6 Jan=Day 0) | Channel | Segments | Window IST / UTC | Subject / SMS + chars | Preview | Offer | CTA | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1a | Day 0, Tue 6 Jan | Email | A+E (10,705) | 10:00 IST / 04:30 UTC | `25% OFF से वापसी करें – We miss you! (38)` | `₹1,600 के box पर ₹400 off, सिर्फ आपके लिए।` | A25 / E25: 25% OFF | Restart My Box | Reactivate / bounce / unsubscribe पर exit |
| 1b | Day 0, Tue 6 Jan | Email | B+D (5,038) | 10:00 IST / 04:30 UTC | `Busy life? Pause/Skip + 20% OFF (36)` | `Travel में pause करें। Pune में delivery फिर शुरू।` | B-FLEX / D-PUNE: 20% OFF | Flexible Restart |同上 + D out-of-area remain excluded |
| 1c | Day 0, Tue 6 Jan | Email | C (1,620) | 10:00 IST / 04:30 UTC | `नई recipes, 35% कम complaints – try again? (49)` | `सितंबर से नया menu, QA सुधरा। Dessert free।` | C-QA: 20% OFF + Free Dessert 1 box | Taste Again | Reactivate पर exit |
| 2 | Day 3, Fri 9 Jan | SMS | SMS-eligible, still-lapsed (4,772 − early converts) | 12:00 IST / 06:30 UTC | `Larder & Vine: Your comeback box is waiting! New recipes + special treat inside. Shop: lv.in/cb Reply STOP to opt out (117)` | — | Dynamic: link से segment offer (stack नहीं) | Shop: lv.in/cb | STOP / reactivate पर exit |
| 3 | Day 7, Tue 13 Jan | Email | All still-lapsed | 10:00 IST / 04:30 UTC | `Last 5 days: आपकी treat expire हो रही है (41)` | `आपका code + पसंदीदा recipes сохра हैं।` | Same as Step 1 | Claim Before Sunday | Reactivate पर exit |
| 4 | Day 12, Sun 18 Jan | SMS | SMS-eligible, still-lapsed | 12:00 IST / 06:30 UTC | `Larder & Vine: Last call! Comeback offer ends Sunday. Renew here: lv.in/cb Reply STOP to opt out (97)` | — | Same, urgency | Renew here | End of campaign, STOP पर suppress |

सभी SMS English GSM-7, ≤160 chars, brand + `Reply STOP to opt out` सहित।

#### 3. Offer Table

Average first box ₹1,600। Dessert cost ₹75/box। Ceiling: **≤₹450 / reactivated**। एक customer = एक offer।

| Segment | Offer (1/customer, no stack) | लागत Calculation | Cost / Reactivated | ≤₹450? |
|---|---|---:|---:|:---|
| Manager प्रस्ताव | 50% OFF + हमेशा free dessert | `0.50×1600=800 + 75×n` = पहले box पर ही ₹875, lifetime uncapped | **≥₹875** | **Fail** |
| A - Price | 25% OFF first comeback box, Code A25 | `0.25×1600` | **₹400** | Pass |
| B - Busy | 20% OFF + Pause/Skip flexibility, Code B20FLEX | `0.20×1600` | **₹320** | Pass |
| C - Quality | 20% OFF + Free Dessert 1 box, Code C20DESSERT | `320+75` | **₹395** | Pass |
| D - Pune mover | 20% OFF Pune Welcome, Code D20PUNE | `0.20×1600` | **₹320** | Pass |
| E - Unknown | 25% OFF first comeback box, Code E25 | `0.25×1600` | **₹400** | Pass |

> Manager का “forever dessert” recurring liability है, finance ceiling तोड़ता है। ऊपर के offers price-objection और trust दोनों address करते हैं।

#### 4. Forecast

**Formula:** `Expected = (Eligible Email − Eligible SMS)×2.1% + Eligible SMS×3.4%`। `Incentive Cost = Expected × Offer Cost`।

| Segment | Eligible Email | Email-only (2.1%) | Email+SMS (3.4%) | Expected Reactivations | Offer Cost | Total Incentive Cost |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 7,720 | 5,620×0.021=118.0 | 2,100×0.034=71.4 | **189.4** | ₹400 | ₹75,768 |
| B | 4,790 | 3,230×0.021=67.8 | 1,560×0.034=53.0 | **120.9** | ₹320 | ₹38,678 |
| C | 1,620 | 1,240×0.021=26.0 | 380×0.034=12.9 | **39.0** | ₹395 | ₹15,389 |
| D | 248 | 196×0.021=4.1 | 52×0.034=1.8 | **5.9** | ₹320 | ₹1,883 |
| E | 2,985 | 2,305×0.021=48.4 | 680×0.034=23.1 | **71.5** | ₹400 | ₹28,610 |
| **Total** | **17,363** | **12,591×0.021=264.4** | **4,772×0.034=162.3** | **~427** | avg ~₹376 | **~₹1,60,328** |

कुल reactivation rate: `427/17,363 = 2.46%`।

#### 5. QA Checklist (CRM Load से पहले)

1. Global suppression 615 हटाएँ; D में सिर्फ 248 Pune email + 52 Pune SMS load करें।
2. SMS सिर्फ `LRDVIN` header + approved template, 10:00-21:00 IST; हर SMS में brand + `Reply STOP to opt out`, English ≤160 chars।
3. Scheduler UTC convert करें: 10:00 IST=04:30 UTC, 12:00 IST=06:30 UTC।
4. एक customer को एक code; stack/block logic + exit on reactivate/STOP/bounce।
5. C creative में “35% fewer complaints + Sept new recipes” claim QA report से match कराएँ।
6. Offer codes (A25/E25/B20FLEX/C20DESSERT/D20PUNE) discount cap ≤₹450 test करें।
